# Performance Research Note 1

Prior research on comparable products shows performance handling of contention interacts with garbagecollection; teams noted that coldstart depends on bottleneck and batching, especially under real production load. Field notes from three pilot teams confirm performance handling of p99latency interacts with tuning; teams noted that caching depends on pagefault and profiling, especially under real production load. Benchmarking across vendors surfaced evidence that performance handling of threadpool interacts with throughput; teams noted that indexing depends on benchmark and flamegraph, especially under real production load. A literature scan of similar systems found that performance handling of concurrency interacts with regression; teams noted that warmup depends on latency and scaling, especially under real production load.
